data.title: XJ International Announces Conditional Disposal Valued at Approximately HKD20.71 Million
data.description:

data.description:

data.title: China Science and Education Reports 2026 Revenue Growth Amid Higher Costs
data.description:
China Vocational Education Holdings Limited ( (HK:1756) ) has shared an update.

For the year ended August 31, 2026, student enrollment rose 6.4% to 59,238 and revenue increased 6.2% year-on-year to approximately RMB1,535.5 million, driven by higher enrollment and average tuition fees. The Group continued operating three schools during the period.

Cost of sales increased 31.1% to approximately RMB947.7 million, mainly due to higher teaching and operating expenditures associated with developing application-oriented universities and implementing related policy requirements. Gross profit fell 18.7% to approximately RMB587.8 million, while the Group reported a RMB344.7 million loss for the year and adjusted net profit declined 49.6% to RMB231.6 million.

data.title: Xiamen Jihong Chairwoman Proposes A- and H-Share Repurchase
data.description:
The latest update is out from Xiamen Jihong Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2603) ).

Xiamen Jihong said its controlling shareholder, de facto controller and chairwoman, ZHUANG Hao, proposed that the company repurchase portions of its RMB-denominated A shares and overseas-listed H shares using its own or self-raised funds. The proposal was submitted on 27 November 2026 and would be conducted through centralized competitive bidding on the Shenzhen and Hong Kong stock exchanges.

ZHUANG said the proposal was intended to establish and improve a long-term incentive mechanism, strengthen the talent pool and motivate management and core employees, while reflecting confidence in the company’s prospects and long-term value. The proposed A-share repurchase price would be capped at 150% of the average trading price over the preceding 30 trading days, while the H-share price would be below 105% of the average closing price over the preceding five business days, subject to board approval of the repurchase plan.

data.title: CHALIECO Enters Approximately RMB6,555.57 Million Guinea Alumina EPC Agreement
data.description:
An update from China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited Class H ( (HK:2068) ) is now available.

China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited, acting as contractor, entered an agreement with Chalco Guinea on 27 November 2026 to provide engineering, procurement and construction general contracting services for the Guinea Alumina Project. The contract price is approximately RMB6,555.57 million and, except for adjustments allowed under the agreement, is not subject to adjustment.

Because Chinalco controls 72.88% of the Company and Chalco Guinea is a subsidiary within the Chinalco group, the agreement constitutes a connected transaction under Hong Kong listing rules. The transaction is subject to reporting, announcement, circular and independent shareholders’ approval requirements.

data.title: China Aluminum International Engineering Names Liu Jing Chairman
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited Class H ( (HK:2068) ).

China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited announced that Li Yihua will resign effective 27 November 2026 as chairman, executive director, member and chairman of the Strategy Committee, and authorised representative. He will leave all positions with the company; Li confirmed that he has no disagreement with the Board.

Effective the same date, executive director Liu Jing was elected chairman and Strategy Committee member and chairman, and appointed an authorised representative alongside executive director Tao Fulun. Liu also serves as the company’s general manager and deputy Party secretary, with his new term running concurrently with the fifth Board session.
